note: Fired clay block dyed with Green Dye (8 terracotta + 1 dye -> 8 dyed terracotta), density ≈ 1600 kg/m³, 1 block = 1×1×1 m. Same aluminosilicate base as terracotta.json plus 1/8 of the dye's pigment amount (split across the 8-block batch).

compounds.name: Chlorophyll (Mg-porphyrin pigment, from cactus), from Green Dye
